description: A toy kitchen setup is in front, with a tall fridge cabinet next to an oven, and plastic foods (bananas, a green lime, an egg, and two cherries) on the countertop. The right hand reaches to the fridge handle and swings the door open toward the left while the left hand stays near the door edge; then the right hand picks up the lime and places it into the lower compartment, adds the two bananas beside it, lifts the egg onto the middle shelf, puts one cherry next to the egg, and finally places the other cherry in the lower compartment before pushing the fridge door closed.
